title: Conversation view lacks auto-scrolling during streaming turn and message arrival
description: The conversation scroll container in EnabledWorkspace.tsx does not anchor or scroll to the bottom when new streaming tokens arrive or when long conversations load, forcing users to manually scroll to read streaming responses.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CONFIRMED live + code.

Live: after long AcceptLoopBot history + new messages, newest content stayed clipped above the fold; manual scroll required.

Code: message list is a plain overflow container with no `scrollIntoView` / stick-to-bottom on new messages or stream tokens.

Fix: auto-scroll when user is near bottom; optional “jump to latest” when they have scrolled up.
